tags.description:
This cenotaph is on grounds of Pallotine Seminary at Green Hill Plantation. Pierre L'Enfant was buried in 1825.
 This body was exhumed (1909) and moved to Arlington Cemetery.
tags.inscription:
Hic multos per annos
requiscebant reliquiae mortales
Petri Caroli L'Enfant
Majoris militaris
apud exercitum nostratem
Mortui  a. d. XVIII K Iul
An MDCCCXXV
Iterum sunt repositae
in spulcretum Arlingtonse
a. d. IV K Mai An MDCCCCIX
R.I.P
tags.name: L'enfant's cenotaph
